verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a localhost API bundled with the desktop app, an official MCP server for AI assistants, and an agents skill that lets Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools 'read, search, and modify Objects' programmatically. The Anytype CLI runs Anytype as a headless server for automation, so no GUI is needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent read/write workflows (the evidence is vendor docs only, and the OpenAPI spec was not found at the probed doc.anytype.io paths).
